best.label: Best picks
best.rule: the selections with the strongest evidence of winning, one per player, at most two per game

availability.label: Availability: the official injury report, shootaround and beat-writer notes, who starts

minutes.label: Minutes: recent rotation, blowout risk from the spread, back-to-back rest

matchup.label: Matchup: opponent defensive rating, pace, who guards whom, rim protection

usage_form.label: Usage and form, last ten games: shots, usage rate, assists per 36, rebound rate

lineup_shifts.label: Lineup shifts: who inherits minutes and shots when a starter sits

game_script.label: Game script: spread, total, pace, overtime risk

line_movement.label: Line movement: opener vs now, with or without news

situational.label: Situational: back-to-backs, travel, altitude (Denver, Utah), rest days

desk_config.note: Settings the NBA research desk follows on every scheduled run, and the defaults the page's Desk settings panel starts from.
desk_config.odds_rule_note: band = only DraftKings prices inside odds_band are eligible (the NBA desk's rule); ignore = evidence picks, the price is shown only
desk_config.lines_note: any = DraftKings' posted line, or a DraftKings alternate line when markets.alts is true; draftkings = posted lines only
